To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

information quality, information system quality, information service quality, perceived ease of using the information system, perceived usefulness of the information system, and securityprivacy are positively correlated to trust in e-governance and that trust in e-govemance has a significant effect on the intention to use the e-governance system.

information system quality, system quality and perceived ease of use positively impact trust in e-government initiative while service quality, information quality, perceived usefulness and security-privacy negatively impact intention to use e-government.
the information systems factors have a significant positive effect on trust in e-government in Palestine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of information systems on trust in e-government.
the relationship between information systems factors and trust in e-governance initiative adoption in the Palestinian public sector.
the relationship between the information system factors and trust in e-Government initiative in Palestinian public sector and the impact of trust on intention to use.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
information systems factors are important in building trust in e-government initiative adoption.
information systems factors are the main factors that contribute to trust in e-governments adoption in the Palestinian public sector.
the information quality, system, service quality and security-privacy are the main factors that affect trust in e-government initiative in Palestine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study was able to provide a better understanding of the factors that influence trust in e-government initiative adoption in Palestine.
this study is the first of its kind to be conducted in the Palestinian public sector and it is the first study to examine trust in e-government in the context of the Arab World.
trust in e-government is an important factor that should be considered when adopting e-government in developing countries such as Palestine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the information system and trust are two sides of the same coin, where one cannot exist without the other.
the trust is a significant factor in the success of e-government initiatives.
the trust in e-government is a key factor that influences the adoption and use of e-government.
